{{Quote|We made sure to build on land the Sand People never used. Didn't matter. They're attacking us, our livestock, our vaporators. Anything they can do to drive us off.|Rinnas Edu|<ref name="TOR:NN" />}}
'''Rinnas Edu''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. While his [[Rinnas Edu's farmstead|farmstead]] was attacked by the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]], he tasked a Republic spacer to assist him in repairing the [[Moisture vaporator/Legends|moisture vaporators]] in the Northern [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]]. Thanking the spacer's help, Rinnas continued to defend his farmstead.<ref name="TOR:NN" />
